english.title: Wildlife - fail to comply with order to remove deterrent notices

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: COUNTRYSIDE AND RIGHTS OF WAY ACT 2000

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with an order dated **(..SPECIFY DATE..) imposed by **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE COURT..) magistrates' court under Section 14(2) of the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000 to remove a notice containing

(A)_[false]_
(B)_[misleading]_

information likely to deter the public from exercising the right of access under Section 2(1) of the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(3) of the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
